about: Platsbanken (Arbetsförmedlingen, the Swedish Public Employment Service job board): search job ads by keyword and municipality, read full ad details, list popular occupations, look up location and occupation taxonomy IDs, and get search suggestions.

commands.summary: Free-text search of Platsbanken job ads (title, employer, occupation, workplace, dates), sorted by relevance or date

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query: occupation, skill, employer or place, e.g. 'systemutvecklare stockholm'

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order: relevance, or date (newest first)

params.name: source
params.description: Ad source: pb = ads published in Platsbanken, joblinks = ads collected from external job sites

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based offset of the first ad to return. The API caps offsets at 2000 (offsetLimit).

commands.summary: Free-text job search limited to one Swedish municipality (municipality ID from get-taxonomy-tree --type LOCATION)

params.name: municipality
params.description: Municipality taxonomy ID, e.g. AvNB_uwa_6n6 = Stockholm. Look IDs up with get-taxonomy-tree --type LOCATION.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order: relevance, or date (newest first)

params.name: source
params.description: Ad source: pb = Platsbanken ads, joblinks = ads from external sites

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based offset of the first ad to return (maximum 2000)

commands.summary: Full details of one job ad: HTML description, employer, workplace address, employment type, working hours, salary type, how to apply

params.name: id
params.description: Job ad ID (the id field from search-jobs), e.g. 31590660

commands.summary: Typeahead suggestions (completions) for a partial job-search query

params.name: q
params.description: Partial search text (word prefix), e.g. 'sjuksk' or 'utveckl'

commands.summary: Occupations with the most open job ads right now, with ad counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of occupations to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Taxonomy tree with IDs used for search filters: LOCATION = regions (län) and their municipalities, OCCUPATION = occupation fields and groups
